name: Aman New York
positioning: Aman's hotel in the Crown Building, on the corner of Fifth Avenue and 57th Street in Midtown Manhattan
best_for: Travelers who want a Midtown base with private Banya or Hammam Spa Houses
Guests who like Japanese-influenced suite design with a fireplace

facts.text: Aman New York is set on the corner of Fifth Avenue and 57th Street.
The hotel occupies the Crown Building, dating from around 1921, a Beaux-Arts landmark.
The Crown Building housed the first iteration of the Museum of Modern Art until 1932.
The Spa Houses are centred around either a traditional Banya or a Hammam experience.
The hotel has a three-floor wellness facility including an indoor pool, Fitness Centre, Cold Plunge Terrace, sauna and steam room.
Arva is Aman New York's signature Italian restaurant.
Akari presents Kaiseki and Omakase at an intimate hinoki wood counter.
The Garden Terrace is open year-round and serves light bites.
The Jazz Club is open to the public.
Suite stays include daily breakfast at Arva or in-suite.

highlights.text: Each private Spa House has a private terrace with a cold plunge and hot bath.
Each suite has a working fireplace.
The Jazz Club is a subterranean venue that hosts evening shows.
Suite design has a Japanese sensibility, such as textured paneling behind the bed that resembles a shoji screen.

considerations.text: Transfers from the area's airports take 30-75 minutes by car.
Alfresco dining is heated and covered during winter.
